cases.title: H.323 gateway cannot establish call to CallManager
cases.reported_evidence: Calls disconnect with cause 38 after the gateway attempts two dial peers; responder notes TCP connection to CallManager is likely failing, potentially due to source binding or name resolution
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare the gateway’s configured H.323 source address and CM name/IP resolution against the packet path; determine which side fails to establish TCP

cases.title: FXS module repeatedly dies after weeks
cases.reported_evidence: A remote PBX extension crosses a leased-line VoIP path and exits an FXS port into a local PBX; replacement FXS cards reportedly fail after about two weeks. No root cause is stated
cases.gameplay_proposal: Inspect physical interface conditions, electrical compatibility, call/load patterns, and whether the failure follows the module or chassis

cases.title: Unity hears prompts but cannot hear recorded message audio
cases.reported_evidence: PSTN callers reach Unity and hear greetings, but Unity hears silence during recording; internal-originated calls can record. Follow-up reports that changing policy routing from source-based to destination-based solved it
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare RTP return paths for internal versus PSTN calls and isolate policy/VPN routing asymmetry

cases.title: New analog gateway ports unexpectedly use translation patterns
cases.reported_evidence: A newly installed analog interface is intended to behave like existing POTS lines, but its calls are affected by translation patterns; the administrator asks how to exempt those ports
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace CSS/partition selection per gateway port and decide where digit normalization belongs

cases.title: VG224 analog calls drop and DTMF/hookflash features fail
cases.reported_evidence: Report includes analog-to-analog calls disconnecting when caller hangs up, delayed dial tone after on-hook, hookflash failing for fax forwarding, and users unable to enter banking PINs
cases.gameplay_proposal: Separate disconnect supervision, hookflash detection, and DTMF relay into independent test cases across the analog call path

cases.title: Repeated nuisance caller consumes attendant-console lines
cases.reported_evidence: Incoming calls from one source repeatedly occupy multiple attendant-console lines; request is to block or send the caller to voicemail. A response describes an inbound calling-number reject translation as an option
cases.gameplay_proposal: Decide between gateway-level reject and controlled voicemail diversion; verify caller-ID normalization and avoid blocking legitimate shared numbers

cases.title: After-hours calls do not route directly to voicemail
cases.reported_evidence: A CCM 4.1(3) administrator says time schedules and partitions are configured but calls outside office hours do not reach voicemail. Reply explains time-of-day partition filtering and gives a routing pattern
cases.gameplay_proposal: Walk through time zone, schedule periods, partition order, CSS, and voicemail route point using an after-hours test call

cases.title: Some PRI outbound calls hang while others connect
cases.reported_evidence: `show voice call summary` shows many channels in setup-fail/release states alongside a few connected or waiting channels; the operator asks whether DSP capacity is implicated
cases.gameplay_proposal: Correlate channel state, Q.931 cause codes, DSP resources, and call concurrency before changing gateway configuration

cases.title: PSTN callers hear “No circuit/channel available.”
cases.reported_evidence: The incident includes Q.931 DISCONNECT signaling with cause 0x8036 for inbound PSTN traffic
cases.gameplay_proposal: Determine whether the carrier, PRI channel allocation, or gateway capacity is returning the unavailable-channel condition by comparing both sides’ signaling

cases.title: New CME phones register only after regenerating configuration files
cases.reported_evidence: On CME 4.1 with per-phone configuration and French/English locales, newly added phones fail to register until `create cnf` is run each time
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare generated per-phone XML and TFTP behavior before and after config regeneration; assess template/locale changes

cases.title: SRST fallback restores a phone’s old extension
cases.reported_evidence: Extension Mobility changes a phone’s DN, but during fallback it returns to an earlier number; resetting the phone and gateway did not clear the behavior
cases.gameplay_proposal: Check fallback configuration and persisted learned DN state; determine whether the stale number is stored on the gateway or provisioned from another source

cases.title: Distinguish internal and external call ringing
cases.reported_evidence: A CCM 4.2 administrator wants different ring patterns for internal and external calls; response says feasibility depends on whether calls are handled by a CTI-based auto attendant or Unity transfer path
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace the call’s redirect/transfer method and determine where external-call identity survives to the phone

cases.title: Music on hold becomes dead air after several seconds
cases.reported_evidence: CCM 6 callers hear MOH for a few seconds, then silence; resetting the media application restores it temporarily. Packet counters and stream direction are suggested diagnostics
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare RTP packet flow at the phone and media resource before and after the five-second boundary

cases.title: Unity voicemail is not delivered and MWI stays off
cases.reported_evidence: Unity 5.01 with Domino integration accepts messages, but subscribers see no new message and receive neither email nor MWI; event log reports UMR delivery failure due to configuration/connectivity with partner mail server
cases.gameplay_proposal: Verify Unity message repository delivery, partner mail connectivity, subscriber mailbox state, and MWI signaling independently

cases.title: Emergency-call alerting and location monitoring requirements
cases.reported_evidence: Administrators discuss how to alert staff when a 911 call is placed and whether the system can expose location/callback information or enable monitoring. This is a design gap, not a reported malfunction
cases.gameplay_proposal: Define the operational response and validate that emergency call location, callback number, and alert reach the right staff

cases.title: CME outbound route sends access digit to the PSTN
cases.reported_evidence: Internal callers dial 9 for an outside call, and the outbound POTS dial peer forwards all digits without stripping the access digit
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace digit transformations from phone to dial peer and choose where the outside-line prefix is removed

cases.title: Inbound FXO calls ring but never reach the attendant DN
cases.reported_evidence: Calls arrive through an MGCP-controlled FXO port from a GSM-to-analog gateway; outbound calls work, but inbound signaling progresses through ring states and then hangs up
cases.gameplay_proposal: Follow ring supervision, answer supervision, and MGCP call setup from the analog device to the configured attendant DN

cases.title: Migrated phones cannot find CME firmware/configuration
cases.reported_evidence: During a move from CallManager to CME, phones report hostname lookup failure, no DNS server, and file-not-found messages; router TFTP/SCCP debug shows no matching requests
cases.gameplay_proposal: Verify DHCP option 150, phone-stored server settings, DNS, TFTP file inventory, and whether phones are contacting the expected host

cases.title: Internal call abruptly plays “cannot be completed as dialed.”
cases.reported_evidence: After a year of working, two registered phones at different sites cannot call each other; the prompt is identified as CallManager annunciator, and the call is not routed to a voice gateway
cases.gameplay_proposal: Inspect CUCM call routing, line state, CSS/partition visibility, and bandwidth/location admission for a local intersite call

cases.title: VG224 SCCP gateway intermittently fails to register
cases.reported_evidence: A gateway port is sometimes unregistered; the eventual follow-up reveals the investigated identifier belonged to an unused, unconfigured FXS port, while the original intermittent fault was no longer reproducible. The thread also considers mixed-mode security and transient unregister defects
cases.gameplay_proposal: Establish a reproducible failure and compare successful/failed SCCP registration traces while verifying each virtual port’s CUCM configuration

cases.title: CUCM 6.1 to 7.0 upgrade fails with generic file-access error
cases.reported_evidence: Upgrade fails after about 45 minutes from DVD and FTP with an unknown upgrade-file error; follow-up says the restored lab system lacked a Nokia S60 device option package present in production, and installing it allowed the upgrade
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare device-option packages and locale inventories between the source and restored lab before retrying an upgrade

cases.title: SIP trunk call has one-way audio after blind transfer
cases.reported_evidence: Incoming trunk calls work directly, but an IP phone transferring to an off-net party without consultation leaves the remote party hearing audio while the phone hears none; thread debates SDP/RTP path and MTP behavior
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare pre-transfer and post-transfer SDP, RTP addresses/counters, and media flow-through/flow-around behavior

cases.title: UC540 calls work one direction between SCCP and SIP phones
cases.reported_evidence: SIP phones can call Cisco phones and voicemail, but Cisco-to-SIP calls do not ring; SIP calls to outside destinations report busy while Cisco outbound works. Registration counters show SIP phones registered
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare dial-peer matching and SIP response behavior in both directions, then inspect the external route’s called-number format

cases.title: ITSP calls ring through instead of forwarding to CUE voicemail
cases.reported_evidence: External calls through an ITSP SIP trunk keep ringing instead of forwarding to CUE; voicemail works when dialed directly. A reply proposes adding B2BUA on the voicemail dial peer
cases.gameplay_proposal: Check forwarded-call signaling and whether the provider/CUE call leg preserves the redirect semantics expected by the voicemail peer

cases.title: H.323 call connects with audio, then drops after five seconds
cases.reported_evidence: Calls between PBXs through two gatekeeper-controlled routers connect with two-way audio for five seconds and then disconnect; responder points to gatekeeper monitoring/disconnect behavior as a possibility
cases.gameplay_proposal: Correlate gatekeeper RAS messages, H.225/H.245 teardown, and disconnect cause at the five-second mark

cases.title: UCCX inbound calls fail while script appears to continue
cases.reported_evidence: UCCX 7 logs show inbound calls failing with cause 107 during CTI Port answer; Cisco responder identifies media negotiation failure with the CTI Port and notes the script may appear to continue despite the failed call
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare CTI Port media/resource negotiation with a successful call and determine whether script handling masks the failed call leg

cases.title: CUCM calls to selected PSTN prefixes have no audio
cases.reported_evidence: CUCM-registered phone calls to specific prefixes/toll-free numbers connect without either party hearing audio; same destinations work from gateway FXS and CME phones
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare RTP paths and SDP across caller types; decide whether CUCM media anchoring differs

cases.title: CCD-over-SAF inbound calls stall in dead air
cases.reported_evidence: Calls from CUCM clusters to remote CME phones produce no progress tones and no ring, while reverse direction works; responders ask whether call is incomplete versus connected without audio and recommend DNA
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace digit analysis and SAF route match, choose between call-routing and media paths

cases.title: Outbound DTMF is not relayed through CUBE
cases.reported_evidence: Inbound provider-to-phone DTMF works, but phone-to-provider DTMF does not on an outbound CUBE SIP call
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare negotiated DTMF relay modes and codec path by direction

cases.title: Phone configuration parses incorrectly despite downloading
cases.reported_evidence: 7945 receives and authenticates signed config, then XML parsing fails; other models also report verify/config issues. Suggestions include wrong device type, outdated load, or corrupted XML
cases.gameplay_proposal: Validate TFTP payload, phone model provisioning, and firmware/time-zone compatibility before changing trust lists

cases.title: Mixed SIP/SCCP endpoints fail hold/resume
cases.reported_evidence: A CUCM 8.6 remote site mixes SCCP with third-party SIP phones; thread concerns hold/resume behavior
cases.gameplay_proposal: Reproduce hold/resume by protocol pair and inspect re-INVITE/REFER signaling

cases.title: Ringing continues after caller abandons inbound call
cases.reported_evidence: Caller disconnects while destination phone is ringing; phone keeps ringing and answering produces silence
cases.gameplay_proposal: Follow CANCEL/BYE handling across provider, CUBE, and CUCM; identify which leg fails to clear

cases.title: Intermittent phone resets drop active calls
cases.reported_evidence: Phones unregister with connectivity error, TCP timeouts and fallback to another CUCM node; seen during network upgrades
cases.gameplay_proposal: Correlate keepalive loss, switch changes, and cluster-node transitions

cases.title: CUCM refresh upgrade stalls at publisher
cases.reported_evidence: Upgrade process times out at publisher despite services appearing up; a reply identifies NTP FQHN beginning with a digit as a known upgrade failure trigger, while another reports CPCD reboot helped a prior stage
cases.gameplay_proposal: Examine upgrade stage, NTP configured hostname versus resolved status, and publisher reachability

cases.title: Music on hold disappears across CUBE
cases.reported_evidence: Basic SIP calls work; on hold, CUCM emits MOH packets but they do not pass CUBE to provider, and audio returns after unhold
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare packet capture and SDP port negotiation across CUBE; decide whether duplex streaming workaround is appropriate

cases.title: VCS route returns 503 before reaching VCS
cases.reported_evidence: CUCM logs 503 for calls routed to VCS; poster later finds the configured port changed and says this explained why calls did not reach VCS, though the overall issue remained partly unresolved
cases.gameplay_proposal: Verify route-pattern target port and confirm arrival in VCS search history

cases.title: Authenticated ITSP registration uses private HA address
cases.reported_evidence: ITSP reports CUBE REGISTER requests sourced from inside VIP rather than public interface; existing unauthenticated trunks continue working
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace registration source interface and compare global versus tenant-specific bind behavior

cases.title: Call recorder receives external mask instead of extension
cases.reported_evidence: CUCM SIP INVITEs to a built-in-bridge recorder include external phone number mask on PSTN calls, while recorder expects four-digit extension
cases.gameplay_proposal: Inspect trunk classification and calling-party transformation context; choose which identity recorder should consume

cases.title: UCCX HA upgrade degrades into fast busy
cases.reported_evidence: After UCCX 10.5-to-11.5 upgrade, calls initially work then both HA nodes begin returning fast busy; failover restores service only briefly; rollback works, roll-forward reproduces after four hours
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare license, Live Data/ECDSA prerequisites, and time-to-failure telemetry before choosing rollback or further upgrade

cases.title: Inbound caller ID displays “Unknown Caller ID.”
cases.reported_evidence: New SIP trunk omits quoted calling number in From field; older trunk included it, and 6921 phones show unknown label with number hidden on the single-line display
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare inbound From/identity headers and determine whether to normalize presentation or preserve privacy behavior

cases.title: Phone call-history browsing sends presence SUBSCRIBE to PSTN trunk
cases.reported_evidence: Opening placed-calls list triggers CUCM presence subscriptions for numbers routed through CUBE; blocking presence in both directions on the trunk stopped the messages
cases.gameplay_proposal: Reproduce with BLF call lists, then scope a presence group policy to the carrier trunk

cases.title: CUBE binding change blocked by lingering call legs
cases.reported_evidence: Adding a new dial-peer/control bind fails while active SIP legs remain; forced shutdown leaves some legs until SIP call service is stopped
cases.cause_status: confirmed (active legs prevent bind change, per observed sequence)
cases.gameplay_proposal: Decide between a drain window and disruptive call clearing; inspect residual legs before reapplying bind

cases.title: Endpoint-local changes revert or fail to sync with CUCM
cases.reported_evidence: CE endpoint settings appear to revert after reset; thread explains that CUCM provisioning can overwrite endpoint values, while supported local changes should synchronize back when provisioned and registered
cases.gameplay_proposal: Check provisioning state and registration, then compare endpoint and CUCM configuration ownership

cases.title: CUCM/CUC/UCCX upgrade risk from replication drift
cases.reported_evidence: In upgrade planning, a CUC subscriber reported healthy replication from publisher but failed when checked locally; historical hostname change left subscriber tables stale and required rebuild
cases.gameplay_proposal: Choose go/no-go based on replication checks performed independently on publisher and subscriber

cases.title: Forwarded caller reaches the wrong voicemail greeting
cases.reported_evidence: PSTN caller reaches Diane, who forwards all calls to Bobbie; question is whether caller can hear Bobbie’s greeting. Discussion identifies global “Last Redirecting Number” behavior and concern over caller experience
cases.gameplay_proposal: Decide voicemail mailbox selection policy and test redirecting-number handling

cases.title: Hunt pilot alerting name missing on phones
cases.reported_evidence: 7800/8800 phones fail to display hunt pilot alerting name after CUCM 11.5(1)SU5+ changed Call-Info formatting; post attributes it to phone firmware defect and shares normalization workaround
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare firmware and Call-Info header before changing SIP normalization

cases.title: UCCX IVR fails after migration from ISDN to SIP
cases.reported_evidence: Inbound IVR calls get 404 although outbound works and dial-peer matching appears correct; reply proposes CSS/partition or trunk device-pool context
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace called number through ingress trunk CSS, partitions, device pool, and routing context

cases.title: CUCM rejects inbound SIP call with 404
cases.reported_evidence: CUCM 12.0 receives INVITE but responds 404; outgoing works and caller has checked CSS and direct phone targeting. Reply raises MTP allocation/DTMF and trunk configuration questions, not a confirmed diagnosis
cases.gameplay_proposal: Inspect inbound called-number normalization, CSS access, MTP allocation and dial-peer signaling

cases.title: 7945/7965 firmware upgrade authentication loop
cases.reported_evidence: After CUCM 10.5(2)SU10, replacement phones repeatedly fail load authentication for a firmware image; installing intermediate and then target COP loads succeeded. Poster suspects bad bundled firmware copy
cases.gameplay_proposal: Separate trust-list diagnosis from image integrity and test staged firmware installation

cases.title: UCCX upgrade rejects CUCM AXL authentication
cases.reported_evidence: During UCCX 10.6-to-12.5 build, Service Provider setup returns CCMAXL authentication exception despite existing AXL user/roles; incorrect password produces a visible credential failure
cases.gameplay_proposal: Check AXL API access, publisher/subscriber target, certificate trust, and logs before rebuilding

cases.title: CUCM bulk device reports truncate on large clusters
cases.reported_evidence: After CUCM 12.5 SU3, export and UDP/phone reports fail around 700–800 devices in clusters with thousands of users and tens of thousands of endpoints; TAC identified two bugs, further rollouts were held
cases.cause_status: confirmed (TAC identified defects; IDs not given in excerpt)
cases.gameplay_proposal: Test report size boundaries and weigh API/CLI extraction against upgrade rollout

cases.title: CUCM reports near-full active partition after migration
cases.reported_evidence: Fresh PCD migration install shows active partition at 98%; reports suggest standard partition threshold may be noisy, while older OVA sizing can make later upgrade/redeployment difficult
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare disk usage and OVA sizing; decide whether alert threshold or capacity migration is warranted

cases.title: External voicemail messages cut off at 49 seconds
cases.reported_evidence: Unity 12.5 SU4 messages from external callers truncate at 49 seconds despite a 300-second limit; internal voicemail calls work, and two sites report it
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare SIP/RTP and gateway timers for external versus internal message sessions

cases.title: T.38 renegotiation yields malformed UDPTL
cases.reported_evidence: Grandstream GXW-4248 fax audio cuts at T.38 renegotiation; re-INVITE appears successful, first UDPTL packet is flagged malformed
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare IFP payload and negotiation with working ATA; isolate firmware vs interop

cases.title: Dynamic T1 fax works for some customers only
cases.reported_evidence: Adtran TA900/Cisco IAD2400 faxing is inconsistent despite T.38 preference, G.711 fallback, QoS, clean circuits, and no observed loss/jitter
cases.gameplay_proposal: Build controlled tests across gateway, fax speed, and analog path

cases.title: H.323 compromise triggers satellite toll calls
cases.reported_evidence: A related customer system reportedly placed concurrent expensive satellite calls, yielding a large bill
cases.cause_status: Confirmed unauthorized calling; precise exploit path unknown
cases.gameplay_proposal: Contain access, preserve CDRs, identify exposed ingress/authentication

cases.title: Known-working number fails on another carrier
cases.reported_evidence: Carrier asks how to resolve subscribers unable to dial a known-working number on another network
cases.gameplay_proposal: Define ownership of trace and collect origin, destination, route, translation evidence

cases.title: No simple nationwide N11 routing map
cases.reported_evidence: Carrier describes maintaining its own geography-sensitive 211/311/511/711/811 translations and asks for machine-readable data
cases.gameplay_proposal: Choose routing key, exception handling, and validation source

cases.title: SBC blocks registrations with IP Request-URI
cases.reported_evidence: Post describes SBC rejecting registrations when Request-URI uses an IP address and suggests a dummy-agent pattern
cases.gameplay_proposal: Normalize, sink, or reject such requests deliberately

cases.title: Follow-me call loses audio after acceptance
cases.reported_evidence: Allworx forwards an inbound call back out; after mobile presses 1, audio disappears both ways although RTP is seen on multiple legs
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace SDP/RTP tuples across re-INVITE and find first unusable leg

cases.title: Ported calls arrive at carrier's own LRN
cases.reported_evidence: Some LNP calls arrive without GAP and route to company PBX because main number equals LRN
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare successful/failed ISUP IAMs; route LRN to monitored sink while tracing

cases.title: Invalid numbers return 503 and are retried
cases.reported_evidence: Call-center dialer treats 503 as transient, repeatedly redialing invalid numbers; carriers map causes as 503/404/604/CANCEL/487
cases.gameplay_proposal: Set retry classes without suppressing valid calls

cases.title: Canadian-origin calls to toll-free numbers blocked
cases.reported_evidence: Canadian DIDs fail to reach some toll-free numbers via several US SIP carriers; US origins work
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare ANI, geography, path, and toll-free translation

cases.title: Intermittent silent calls to mobile network
cases.reported_evidence: Calls to Rogers connect but lack far-end audio across wholesale carriers/interconnects; SS7 traces show little inbound media after ringing
cases.cause_status: Proposed — destination network suspected, not confirmed
cases.gameplay_proposal: Correlate by destination, route, time; escalate with traces

cases.title: NATed endpoint becomes unreachable
cases.reported_evidence: Post discusses TCP keepalive, TLS heartbeat, or SIP OPTIONS to maintain reachability; OPTIONS timeouts can tear down registration
cases.gameplay_proposal: Balance detection time against signaling load

cases.title: SPA1x2 locks up or stops registering
cases.reported_evidence: Ports randomly show off-hook, reject calls, fail registration, or web portal hangs across firmware versions
cases.gameplay_proposal: Gather firmware/hardware cohort and port telemetry before replacement

cases.title: Text-enabled number routing needs portability data
cases.reported_evidence: Discussion notes accurate routing for voice and text and portability-corrected NNID identifiers
cases.gameplay_proposal: Define inventory checks before porting text-enabled numbers

cases.title: LNP numbers may hit wrong tandem
cases.reported_evidence: Discussion describes ported blocks that should route by LRN but may follow thousand-block/tandem homing
cases.gameplay_proposal: Determine whether failed calls track LRN or legacy rate-center route

cases.title: Verifier rejects locally signed PASSporTs
cases.reported_evidence: Calls with customer Identity header fail validation while calls without it pass using carrier-generated PASSporT, across two carriers
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare TN, certificate chain, header preservation, and signing claims per hop

cases.title: Identity headers disappear on toll-free paths
cases.reported_evidence: Test tool reports limited success receiving Identity headers on toll-free numbers from multiple providers
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare geographic DID and toll-free call paths to locate header loss

cases.title: Asterisk runs out of RTP ports under call-center load
cases.reported_evidence: Asterisk acting as SIP/media proxy for about 30 agents is reported unable to allocate RTP ports; config shows a bounded RTP range
cases.cause_status: Proposed (port capacity is a lead, not proven)
cases.gameplay_proposal: Compare concurrent calls/conferences to allocated ports and decide whether to expand range or capacity

cases.title: SIP reachability checks miss failed call completion
cases.reported_evidence: Operator asks for automated end-to-end tests beyond ping/SIP gateway availability, covering legacy numbers, multiple routes, and actual media
cases.gameplay_proposal: Design synthetic calls that verify both signaling and recorded tones/media

cases.title: IVR fails when caller sends in-band DTMF
cases.reported_evidence: School IVR accepts RFC2833 only; some callers support in-band DTMF and the SBC/softswitch path cannot transcode
cases.gameplay_proposal: Choose a DSP-capable SBC or adjust endpoint/media path and test digit recognition

cases.title: Public SBC answers unsolicited SIP probes
cases.reported_evidence: Internet-visible SBC responds to INVITE and REGISTER probes with 403 despite the trunk use case not requiring remote registrations; security policy is under review
cases.gameplay_proposal: Decide source filtering and allowed methods while preserving legitimate carrier interconnect

cases.title: Caller ID differs between From and P-Asserted-Identity
cases.reported_evidence: Operators discuss which SIP identity header governs caller ID and interconnect behavior
cases.gameplay_proposal: Trace header values across trusted boundaries and choose canonical identity handling
